segments.name: Multi-family Properties
segments.description: Owns, operates, and holds interests in multi-family apartment properties primarily in the Southeast and Texas.
segments.evidence: We are an internally managed real estate investment trust, also known as a REIT, that owns, operates, and to a lesser extent, holds interests in joint ventures that own and operate multi-family properties.

revenueModel.text: Residents pay monthly rent on one-year leases at market rates for apartment units; commercial tenants pay base rent on longer-term leases.
revenueModel.evidence: Rental revenue from multi-family properties is recorded when due from residents and is recognized monthly as it is earned.
